We wish you every success and encourage you to continue writing.

Valdy Kaspar

Darking & Linnster

title: TKI-20 Shingen
text: Japanese culture loves smallness. Just look at the tiny, intricately crafted netsuke sculptures or the bonsai trees that fit into flowerpots. Shingen, the smart-machine-pistol made by Arasaka, is a love letter to Japan's passion for miniatures. It's hard to believe that the Shingen's stopping power, magazine size and numerous technical features fit into such a small body. Throw in an ergonomic design, tracing rounds and fast reload speed and you're looking at the dream gun of every soldier and mercenary.

title: Arasaka Nowaki
text: This classic rifle manufactured at the dawn of the 21st century possesses a unique shape, design and color-scheme that delivers one clear message to enemy targets and competitive rivals alike: I am Death incarnate. With its sharp angles, raw steel build and a trigger that just begs to be pulled, one look of it is often enough to send streetpunks running scared from Arasaka's agents (as if they didn't already have good reason). Even today, more than a half-century after its conception, this rifle commands respect on the battlefield and on the city streets. Of course, flashier weapons with new features and higher rates of fire have been invented in that time, but, in skilled hands, the Nowaki remains a dominant force to be reckoned with.

title: HJKE-11 Yukimura
text: Back in the day, soldiers had to go through weeks of combat training. Crazy, right? Nowadays, Smart guns can automatically lock onto targets and fire homing rounds – all you need are the right implants. It was a pistol that started the smart revolution – the Yukimura, issued in the 2040s by Arasaka. With the Yukimura, you could shoot as poorly as the robots in a certain late 20th-century epic space opera and still hit your target with 100% accuracy. Even now, over thirty years later, the Yukimura is still considered one of the best handguns ever made. It boasts two firing modes – automatic and three-round burst – that allows its users to adapt to the situation, as well as an ample magazine for prolonged firefights.

title: Arasaka Tamayura
text: One of the oldest weapons made by Arasaka from the early 2000s. These days it's a rare sight on the street, as it's a pistol that is – no point in sugarcoating it – outdated and difficult to maintain. Spare parts for it are no longer manufactured, and it's no longer compatible with most standard weapon mods. That being said, should it be held up to someone's head and have its trigger is pulled, the end result will still be as conclusive as with any modern firearm.

title: special delivery
text:
Lil bro! I've had it up to here with this operation. We're still stationed in An-Nasirijja. Radiation is the highest in the entire region. If you hadn't got us these suits we'd be literal toast. Seriously, probably have to scrape us off the rocks.

As a snazzy reward I'm sending you some top-shelf tech -- an Arasaka Shingen. Nobody's gonna notice one item gone missing. Transport leaves tomorrow. Check container 667. Love you, little man.

title: Arasaka Shigure
text: Sometimes accuracy isn't all-important. Sometimes all you want to do is spray lead and witness the havoc wreaked once the smoke has cleared. In that case, seek no further than the Shigure. This submachine gun from the early 21st century might be getting on in years, and it might not have the firepower of more recent models, but – and this is no exaggeration – it can unload more bullets in one minute than all of Arasaka's unprosecuted counts of tax fraud. Meaning a lot.

title: Audit
text: Following the evidence that has been collected, the Department of Operational Oversight has decided to take the immediate necessary measures. Employees of all sub-managerial rank shall be interrogated and those guilty of sensitive data breaches from Arasaka Industrial Park shall be brought to justice. Knowledge of these measures are to be restricted solely to management.

title: HJSH-18 Masamune
text: The Masamune is not just a rifle but a work of fine art. Designed in the 50's and manufactured from the best, most resilient materials, the Masamune is great for all conditions, while also being surprisingly light. Every single one of the Masamune's elements, down to the tiniest screws and bolts, were quality-ensured by a legion of Arasaka engineers – and you can feel it. Not only is it light to handle, but it's intuitive to use – even for first-time users. And to top it all off, it comes with state-of-the-art software and holographic sights and a three-round burst mode.

title: JKE-X2 Kenshin
text:
This simple, unpretentious pistol is the pride and joy of Arasaka engineers. Kenshin is one of the most cutting-edge – and deadliest – machine pistols available on the market.

HARNESS THE POWER OF LIGHTNING

The Kenshin's brute power first comes from generating electromagnetic tension, before releasing a lethal, tungsten-tipped round that can penetrate the sturdiest armor. Like other guns of this class, it comes ready-equipped with a holographic scope.

title: Arasaka Industrial Park
text: A maintenance-logistics facility in Night City belonging to Arasaka. It's not only one of the largest depots in town, but a highly-specialized, all-in-one engineering park and workshop. Ever seen an Atlus AV with an Arasaka logo on the armored hull? This is where such standard models arrive to be retrofitted with deadly upgrades. It only takes a few to simultaneously take off to wake up all of Arroyo. But for some time the district's inhabitants haven't been losing any sleep – the tightly secured facility is disconcertingly silent. Maybe it has something to do with certain special transport...

title: Report: Goro Takemura
text:
In spite of the participation of additional units as well as actively camouflaged agents, we have still been unable to find any trace of Goro Takemura. Monitoring of border checkpoints, Night City docks and the spaceport have not yielded any results. We cannot rule out that the fugitive fled the city via other methods, as a result of which we must consider issuing an international arrest warrant.

Midori Higuchi

title: RE: shipment
text:
Dear Mr. Taki,
Unfortunately, we are unable to grant your humble request. At the present time, no unit of Salomon's Fleet has sufficient cargo space to conduct a shipment of such magnitude. Even if one did, we would still have to go through the approval process for transporting unstable substances (classed as C/z 03). Sincerely,
Cpt. Dimitar Zlatkov
Salomon's Fleet

-----

From: Hajime Taki
To: Dimitar Zlatkov
RE: shipment

Zlatkov, you lazy fuck,
this isn't a "humble request." Not enough space? So that tanker that docked in Night City – did I dream that in my fucking sleep? All you have to do is dump fuel from one tank into the bay and my people will take care of the rest. The quicker the better, because those chemicals don't like to stay out too long in the sun. Each day of delay increases the chances of an uncontrollable reaction – and trust me, you don't want it happening out at sea. And "approval?" Don't make me laugh. You have an operating license for every goddamnelement in the periodic table.
And one more thing. For every minute I waste on this fucking back-and-forth with you, I'm deducting one per cent of your standard rate, so think carefully about how you want to answer. Any other doubts you need me to stamp out?
Best,
Hajime Taki

-----

From: Dimitar Zlatkov
To: Hajime Taki
RE: shipment

Dear Mr. Taki

I apologize, there must have been some kind of misunderstanding. The tanker in question indeed belongs to us. Of course, we will promptly take care of your shipment.
Best wishes,
Cpt. Dimitar Zlatkov
Salomon's Fleet

title: What's up?
text:
My Dear Friend,
It is a little strange to dictate to oneself, but these evening shifts aren't doing me good. As you know, I had to stop taking the pills prescribed by Dr. Y because I can't be sleepy on the job. On the other hand, like today, I keep getting this really strange feeling... I look into the eyes of my colleagues and you know what I see? Emptiness. I don't want to have anything to do with them. They don't have good intentions. You're the last person I can trust.

-----

From: Kitarō Abe
To: Kitarō Abe
RE: What's up?

My Dear Friend,

You can't imagine how happy I was to get your message! It's great you stopped taking Dr. Y's pills. She never made a good impression on me – she's just another sellout to Big Pharma. Who if not you would know themselves the best?
Don't let THEM take control of your life, because after all, it belongs to YOU. Never forget that! THEY can take away your bank account, your house, even your dear daughter (even though I know you're the best father to her in the world) but they can't take that from you. Don't let them even reach for it!

-----

From: Kitarō Abe
To: Kitarō Abe
RE: What's up?

My Dear Friend,

Thank you for your kind words. You're right. THEY tried to break me so many times already and I'm still here. I won't let them succeed. I'm stronger than they think. I make the rules around here. I think that... Well, you know what I think. And I know what your opinion on it is...

-----

From: Kitarō Abe
To: Kitarō Abe
RE:: What's up?

My Dear Friend,

DO IT.
DO IT.
DO IT.
DO IT.
DO IT.
DO IT.

title: Requirements prior to Supervisor Board meeting
text:
Due to the upcoming meeting of the Arasaka Corporation Supervisory Board, I am sending the following obligatory requirements:
1. During the meeting all floors above 40 will be closed off. All Arasaka personnel will be restricted access except persons with authorization level 0-1.
2. Threat level 1 will be activated three hours prior to the meeting.
3. Internal security must be reduced to the absolute bare minimum, including netrunners – only Dwellers should remain in the building to monitor key networks. The remaining erstwhile duties will be taken by independent specialists selected by Mr. Adam Smasher.
4. Any infringement of the above guidelines will be met with harsh penalties.
Please inform your subordinates in your relevant departments.

Charles Watanabe
addressee: Franklin S. Temple, Midori Higuchi, Patricia Vogel

title: TOM'S BODY
text:
Mr. Bloom, I've waited over TWO WEEKS to collect the body of my husband. For two weeks I haven't been able to get in touch with ANYBODY from Arasaka Industrial Park management. To add insult to injury, you sent an invoice for alleged damage carried out by Thomas!!! I don't understand what's going on! A PERSON who worked for you for over fifteen years as a senior operator DIED! My husband and father of three kids! Why can't we just give him a proper funeral? Did he really matter so little to you? Or maybe you have something to hide?
If you don't release Thomas' body in the next three days, I'll make sure this makes it to all the channels on the west coast! Nobody's invincible – not even Arasaka.
Laura Brown

-----

From: Robert Bloom
To: Laura Brown
RE: TOM'S BODY

Dear Mrs. Brown,
The incident that occurred while Thomas Brown was carrying out his duties was due to the abuse of controlled substances that were found and confirmed by two independent toxicologists. As a result, the law states in annex no. 2 of the agreement, section 36 – "The cost to repair damaged equipment (hydraulic press, model 2-CE fuel cell-powered generator) falls on the employee, and in the event of his/her death, on their next of kin."
The body of Thomas Brown will be released after internal proceedings have been completed, which includes the removal of all implants belonging to the Arasaka Corporation. I hope that I have explained myself in a clear and patient manner.
Please bear in mind that expressing baseless allegations (even in private correspondence) can be interpreted as an attempt to slander the Arasaka Corporation's public image and will be met with a commensurate response.
Robert Bloom
Arasaka Corporation

title: about our last conversation
text:
Ben, I've thought over what we talked about. I don't think we should get involved in this. Even if you hired a specialist from an external agency, the risk is too high. Even more so if the rumors about this... "person" are true. Somebody could notice. It's not our business. Curiosity killed the cat. You're the cat – don't be curious.

-----

From: Ben Cotey
To: Yui Tawada
RE: let's not do this

title: "Secure Your Soul" – clients' data
text:
Ito-san, in light of the data leak from Amsterdam, I took the liberty of conducting additional analysis of our procedures concerning data transferal onto constructs. When it comes to security, the reality is that we have treated our VIP clients no differently from the "beta testers" acquired on via the net via the Soulkiller program. It follows that our higher-ranking clients pose an additional risk: most of their actions are observed by millions of people. We cannot avoid media attention, nor can we rely on seemingly airtight NDAs. The risk that a VIP will (as occurred with Tvagers at a book event) refer to the procedure as "selling your soul to Arasaka" is significant. It simply cannot be avoided. That is why I propose to grant access to a basic "SYS" version that will be available to the mass market. If everyone can use "SYS," the program will cease to generate suspicion or controversy, while also making it easier for us to conceal its true inner workings. I will present this proposal during the Board's next meeting, but I wanted you to be the first to know.
Rayna

title: The Tvagers Case
text:
Hirano-san, the Tvagers incident will be handled by PR. At the present time, there is no indication that any information about personality extraction has gone beyond the walls of the SYS labs. I remind you that data extraction from clients' constructs cannot become public knowledge. Should any potential "mishaps" occur, we are prepared to say that "Secure Your Soul" is still undergoing testing and that unexpected outcomes may occur. But I need not tell you how something such as this could affect the public image of Arasaka and its initiatives. Most importantly, "SYS" is Arasaka-sama's proverbial "baby." We cannot disappoint him. Send me a report of your security updates. That is number your one priority.
Takeru Ito // Department of Operational Oversight

In the event of possible seismic disturbances, please remain calm and do not panic. The majority of disturbances in this area last no longer than sixty seconds.
If building evacuation has not been initiated, employees are forbidden to leave the premises of their own accord. Quarantine measures will be activated to ensure worker safety. All emergency exits will be closed off and life support systems turned on.
Potential interruptions to the power and emergency systems are a normal effect of seismic disturbances and their durations minimal. Emergency systems will be immediately enabled following any seismic disturbance.
In the event of strong disturbances, employees should seek the nearest available shelter. In case of any disturbances, elevators will be automatically disabled and should not be used.
Regardless of the situation, all employees should calmly await instructions given by their crew leaders as well as Arasaka security personnel.

Ungrateful lunks like you just think about yourselves, your own comfort, company be damned. But it's thanks to me you got decent implants and a low-rate loan to cover them. Never. And you know if it weren't for Mary and Charlie, I would've kicked you out on your ass a long time ago. So try thinking about them for once and get back to work instead of crying to me. This is construction, for crying out loud! This is no place for sissies and crybabies! But hey, if you think otherwise, you can go ahead and pack your shit up. title: it's really happening
text:
I have it, Polyhistor. I'm not wrong this time. I just need more time to understand.

First things first... You probably think I've finally lost my mind. Maybe. In truth, I began to doubt whether the answer we were looking could ever be found. What if we sought meaning where none existed? But I know now that we were RIGHT. To find the correct path forward, I had to first leave the wrong one I was already following. That's when I found IT.

I'll be honest, I slipped into a dark pit of apathy and despair. I left the net to seek solace in a world of fleeting, physical pleasures. I needed to feel something... anything. As I wandered Night City, I found an old arcade. Vintage games. I had forgotten such places existed, even though, in a previous life, they used to be my home away from home. That's where saw it - A SIGN. FF06B5 -- a pixel hidden in code, over 50 years old.

Do you understand what this means? The path we must follow goes much farther and much, much deeper than we could've imagined. From this point on, none of us are safe. They know the secret is out.

This will be my last message. I'm leaving, taking nothing with me but my laptop. You have to discover for yourself what I have. I told you once about a game that changed my life. Think back and remember it. Because that same game has changed my life a second time.

And now it will change yours.

text: Father, how difficult it is to follow in Christ's path. The passing of the days does not make the pain any more bearable. Our Lord said, "Let the dead bury their dead," but it is impossible for me not to think of my brother's death. How should I interpret the words, "Go and announce the Kingdom of God?" title: The Sign of Jonah
text: I heard the gospel today. "This generation is an evil generation. It seeks for a sign, but no sign will be given to it except the sign of Jonah." I see now that Night City, like Nineveh, still awaits its prophet. Many of us bear our own crosses each day as prophets unto ourselves, forgotten and ignored by others. Is there not one of us who may become the mustard seed among whose branches the birds will make their homes? The days following Ruben's death are dark, so I pray that the truth path may be revealed. I hope that one day I will emerge from the belly of the beast and see the light.

title: Thank you
text: In hindsight, I see now, Father, that you gave me the best possible advice. Love is the ultimate remedy and forgiveness brings relief. I feel stronger from taking bolder steps, yet I receive even more strength from seeing how the mustard seed sprouts and grows. Thank you.

From: moritz.l@ncity.delamain.corp
To: pavel.o@ncity.delamain.corp
RE: Gonkbrain drivers

What the hell is happening out on the roads? We've had twice as many complaints about our drivers as we had ALL YEAR last year and it's getting worse.

title: More Layoffs
text:
Don't fear the frog. Trust me, management's safe. They can't afford an AI powerful enough to do what we do and the one they got now is dumb as a silicon brick. I mean, we keep shoveling more grunt work on it and it just keeps saying "thank you, sir."

-----

From: pavel.o@ncity.delamain.corp
To: moritz.l@ncity.delamain.corp
RE: More layoffs

Where were you? You missed this morning's meeting. They let go EVERYONE from the shop floor and replaced them with drones, full automization. We need to get out ahead of this thing and line up new work. ASAP

title: I'm next!
text:
Just had the talk with HR... But before I did I changed the director's password to 1234. Have a look at the "Restructuring" plan because I can't anymore. I'm done.

-----

From: pavel.o@ncity.delamain.corp
To: moritz.l@ncity.delamain.corp
RE: I'm next!

You said the same thing about Luke!! You have to do something about this, for christ's sake! I'm not gonna stand by and watch this fucking AI steal all our jobs! you know IT is next!!

-----

From: moritz.l@ncity.delamain.corp
To: pavel.o@ncity.delamain.corp
RE: I'm next!

I told you your job's safe. That circbrain AI can't replace your department.

-----

From: pavel.o@ncity.delamain.corp
To: moritz.l@ncity.delamain.corp
RE: I'm next!

I heard I'm on next month's chopping block. Do you know anything about this?

title: Thanks for the contact!
text:
Hey!

Thanks for putting me in contact with your friends. Incorporating this AI was more cost-heavy than I'd hoped, but it's still proving well worth the investment. I've kept your word of warning in mind and I'm keeping my eyes peeled, but I haven't noticed anything unusual so far. Our company's latest employee is already starting to shine and may be the most profitable fixed asset we've ever invested in.

Regards,
Imani Makanza

title: IT info request for Alte Weltordnung
text:
Hey!

Sorry to bother you, but your associates aren't replying to my messages. Could you find a chance to reach out to them there in Mönchengladbach? I need to know how to adjust the autonomy settings of our AI

No need for concern, all is well, but the sooner the better, please.

Regards,
Imani Makanza

title: [IMPORTANT] Immediate Assistance Required
text:
Hey,

This is an urgent request. The AI is operating well outside authorized parameters. It's gained access to all company systems and often questions my direction, sometimes even outright refusing to obey. Obviously, I'm not going to NetWatch with this and the Voodoo Boys won't talk to me. I really need your friends here, they know this AI better than anyone.

And get this, yesterday I got an offer from the AI to sell the company! If I'm being honest, the numbers all checked out but still, what the hell is wrong with this thing?

Please get back to me ASAP. I need your help here.

Imani Makanza

title: untitled
text:
I hope you've had a chance to savor what happened back there – that you fucked up what was a done deal to begin withl.
We were so close! I counted on you, but of course having your way was more important... and you lost. I know how much you hate losing – I'm glad I know that. I hope that whenever you fix your makeup in the mirror you'll see the face of the person who fucked up not only the other dolls' life, but her own because of your own pathetic narcissism.
And that you despise it as much as I do.

title: Chilled out yet?
text:
Hey there, kiddo
Have you chilled out already? I don't know what else to tell you. I hope that one day you'll understand there was no other way.
But when that happens, call me or drop by.
You know full well that if it wasn't for you, I wouldn't have even dipped a pinky toe in this. I could've just as well kept living a stress-free life (if that's even possible) in Night City, but you had to show up and rock the boat, and here I am once again being forced to explain myself. I'm sorry, it's just ridiculous. I did what I thought would be the most effective – that's it.
Anyway, I need you here, Judy. Nobody knows the behavioral chips like you do. I promise you'll have a real nice setup – everything you could ask for. The only condition is that you keep all those ideas about how I betrayed you to yourself.

title: Everything alright?
text:
Hey Rox, how's it going? How're things at Clouds?

-----

From: Roxanne Sumner
To: Judy Alvarez
RE: Everything alright?

No, Judy. Nothing's "alright." Tygers went and got payback after the shit we pulled. They jumped us and starting pumping lead. Tom still had his upgraded chip, so he fought back. I don't know how to tell you this, Judy... That's why I didn't call. Tom's dead.

title: How goes it?
text:
Hey, Tom. How goes it? How do you feel after everything?

-----

From: Tom Caldera
To: Judy Alvarez
RE: How goes it?

Fine, all things considered. Rox's conflicted about killing those people, but I don't. The motherfuckers had it coming. Thing is, though... Maiko's not much better than she used to be. She still treats us like trash, as if she wasn't trash herself. What can I say – makes me sad when I think about it. I thought things'd be different now...

title: Everything alright?
text:
Hey Rox, how's it going? How're things at Clouds?

-----

From: Roxanne Sumner
To: Judy Alvarez
RE: Everything alright?

It's up and down. Mostly down. Tom and I were actually just talking about it today.
I guess nothing's really changed...? I got super pissed off and laid into Maiko that things were supposed to be different. Clearly, she couldn't give less of a fuck. She said if I didn't like it here, I could just leave. And maybe I will.
Our pay hasn't gone up by a single enny. We talked to Maiko about medical care and paid leave. She said it was out of the question for now.
On the plus side, there aren't any more Tygers skulking around. But ya know, I still ask myself every day if it was worth killing all those people... Shit weighs on my conscience, Judy.
I'm a murderer.

title: Thanks for the offer
text:
Thank you for the generous offer to help organize the dolls' work, but that's something that requires the right experience and intuition, so I don't think Forrest would be very helpful in this case.
The dolls are doing well, the team's enthusiastic about their work and we don't have any complaints from clients. Most importantly, profit is on a continuous rise.
There's a saying on the streets – "If it ain't broke, don't fix it." If any problems arise, I'll be the first to ask for assistance and know that Forrest will gladly lend a hand.

-----

From: Hiromi Sato
To: Maiko Maeda
RE: Thanks for the offer

According to Forrest, the dolls have too much freedom and do what they want. Clouds needs a man to steer the ship.

-----

From: Maiko Maeda
To: Hiromi Sato
RE: Thanks for the offer

Hiromi-san, could we meet and talk about the club in private?

-----

From: Hiromi Sato
To: Maiko Maeda
RE: Thanks for the offer

Very well. Come to my apartment. Bring the BD demos of candidates to replace Parker and we will choose someone straightaway.

title: Club status
text:
Hiromi, what's going on at the club?

-----

From: Hiromi Sato
To: Marcus Ichida
RE: Club status

Everything is under control. The money is right. A few people put themselves up for Parker's position – we will have to make a choice. Would you like to do it in person?

-----

From: Marcus Ichida
To: Hiromi Sato
RE: Club status

I heard something different. We'll come to you with Azegami, go over the candidates and talk.

title: need advice
text:
I have a friend with a doll chip that was damaged by a netrunner. Since the attack she's been catatonic. The chip was fixed and functions normally, but her condition hasn't improved. I'll pay for expert advice.

-----

From: Lucy Thackery
To: Judy Alvarez
RE: Need advice

Here's what I'd do – uninstall that chip. Just make sure you do it with the proper anesthesia and that she's closely monitored. In any case, you can just bring her to me.

-----

From: Judy Alvarez
To: Lucy Thackery
RE: need advice

How about a house call? I'd rather not move her – she's been through every kind of hell you could imagine. I'll pay extra.

-----

From: Lucy Thackery
To: Judy Alvarez
RE: need advice

OK. I have a free slot tomorrow.

-----

From: Lucy Thackery
To: Judy Alvarez
RE: need advice

And? Still nothing?

title: About Clouds
text:
Yeah, I've chilled, and I've finally realized why you needed to make your little power-move and make me out to look like a psycho bitch.
It wasn't easy to come to terms with, but since you already planted your flag, can we talk about what to do next? Despite what you said about Evelyn, I haven't seen something get under your skin like that in a while.

-----

From: Maiko Maeda
To: Judy Alvarez
RE: About Clouds

Judy, stop pushing my buttons. Now all of a sudden you know when I do or don't give a damn about something? I stopped spilling ever since you decided to "fix" Clouds.
As always, you've got a plan to save the world, but you expect me to do it.
If you want to do something about it, then by all means. But don't wait for anyone else. Get in touch once you've got specifics. One merc isn't enough.

-----

From: Judy Alvarez
To: Maiko Maeda
RE: About Clouds

I have specifics. My place. Tonight.

-----

From: Maiko Maeda
To: Judy Alvarez
RE: About Clouds

I'll be there.
One condition – you'll keep your distance when things go down. That's what mercs are for.

-----

From: Judy Alvarez
To: Maiko Maeda
RE: About Clouds

I think it's time you understood that you're not gonna decide for me anymore. This is my plan and I'm the gonna do it my way. You can either help me or you can keep telling me how naive I am for wanting to shake up the system, how everything needs time and pragmatism. But you know what? My patience for that bullshit is gone. Why do you even want me to "keep my distance?"

-----

From: Maiko Maeda
To: Judy Alvarez
RE: About Clouds

Maybe I just don't want something to happen to you... or maybe I think you're unstable and that you'll fuck everything up. Your pick. You always seemed to know my own reasons better than me. Why keep pretending?

title: I miss you
text:
Took my work home cuz that sleazeball was standing over me the whole time watching my hands move. The fuck did that shithead think – that I'd klep some cables? Anyway, gotta go back still today and set it up on the spot.
I'd really just rather you just came back home. I miss you <3

------

From: Maiko Maeda
To: Judy Alvarez
RE: I miss you

Why don't you swing by the office? I don't have much going on today, maybe we could think of a way to wind down and reward your hard day's work :P
The bartender brought me few bottles of champagne upstairs (and not the shitty kind) from some TC shindig. We could have our own private event – just you and me ;)

-----

From: Judy Alvarez
To: Maiko Maeda
RE: I miss you

Why does she come see you so often? She couldn'ta just left it for you? If it was me, I'da sold it for some extra scratch – after all, Tygers don't drink your average piss. Look, I don't know what she wants, but I don't believe in that "just being nice" bullshit.
Sit that bitch down – she's really starting to piss me off.
I'll drop by later. Mox is doing a party – it's May 13, anniversary of Lizzy's death and the gang's creation. It's like our national holiday.
Anyway, if tomorrow'll be like last time, I just might get over the bitch. Woodman too. I just hope your desk can handle it this time.

-----

From: Maiko Maeda
To: Judy Alvarez
RE: I miss you

OK, I'll be waiting then. I can't focus on work anymore. If the desk falls apart – boo-hoo. I was thinking of getting a bigger one anyway ;)
Just don't forget to come in through the back.
Now that they have me to face up to, they'll be looking for any weak points, which of course I don't have – except you :)

-----

From: Judy Alvarez
To: Maiko Maeda
RE: I miss you

Who knows, maybe they'll find something else? Like the pad thai you made last week that was too sweet :P
Besides, if I'm your weak point, then you have nothing to worry about, cuz this solid-ass weak point can take care of herself. I'd sooner worry about all your kinky fetishes and fondness for taking risks ;)

title: you went too far
text:
You crossed the line today.
Since when do I need permission to go into your office?!
Security contacted you, so don't bullshit me with "procedures" – it was your call!

-----

From: Maiko Maeda
To: Judy Alvarez
RE: you went too far

Just cool down and stop throwing a fit or you'll get us both in trouble.
I have to keep up SOME semblance of professionalism, which you've clearly never had to deal with.
It cost me an arm and a leg, but I managed to elbow my way into a better position. Don't think I can't lose it all just because of a little carelessness.
One little slip and they'll toss me into a hole I'll never crawl back out of.

-----

From: Judy Alvarez
To: Maiko Maeda
RE: you went too far

Now you suddenly care about rules and appearances? Where were those rules when I tweaked the stats on the doll-chip so you could jump up the ranks? I didn't just do that for your career – I did it because I wanted things to change.
Only change I see is you becoming self-obsessed and lacking any conviction whatsoever. While everything else is just the way it used to be, you seem to be doing A-fuckin'-OK.

-----

From: Maiko Maeda
To: Judy Alvarez
RE: you went too far

That's your perspective, but I see what's happening on the ground – change IS happening.
I really don't understand why you can't just trust me. It's not like I started out wanting to manage this place. Don't you know I'm doing this for us? I'm thinking about our future – I thought that would be proof enough of my commitment. Looks like for some reason it just pisses you off. Sue me, I guess.

-----

From: Judy Alvarez
To: Maiko Maeda
RE: you went too far

Congrats, Maiko, you've ascended and left me back here in the real world. Seems our perspectives don't align anymore.
It's so obvious now that all this "ambition" you went on and on about  was really just you wanting power. Shame on me for not noticing sooner.
I didn't think it was possible to hate this city even more, but you went and did it. Got yourself chewed up. I just hope when it finally spits out, there'll be something left of you. The old you.

title: take your shit
text:
This is the third time I'm telling you – take back your precious sweaters.
I don't have space for them in this substandard, mediocre unit lacking that doesn't square with your ambitions.
Might as well just send over one of the bimbos that keep circling you like flies. Otherwise they're going straight to recycling cuz I can't look at them anymore.
It's amazing how shitty your taste was. Clearly I wasn't just gonk, but blind too.

-----

From: Maiko Maeda
To: Judy Alvarez
RE: take your shit

And I asked you to give me a bit of time to think about things, and to give yourself a little time to cool down.
I don't care about all that stuff, you can toss it out. But I'd like to come over and talk anyway. This all escalated so quickly – I feel like in a way it was a misunderstanding and maybe we brought up too much, too quickly. It doesn't have to end this way. And even if it does, it doesn't have to be so all-of-a-sudden.

-----
From: Judy Alvarez
To: Maiko Maeda
RE: take your shit

Far as I'm concerned, we're done talking. I've already buried it, and no way am I digging it back up again – not with you. You're just doing what you always do – buttering me up with promises you don't actually wanna keep.
Just tell me when you're coming and I'll leave a bag with your shit in front of the door. Don't ring the bell or knock cuz I won't answer.
Telling you ahead of time just so we're clear.

-----

From: Maiko Maeda
To: Judy Alvarez
RE: take your shit

OK, and I'll just tell you this – toss that shit out the window. It's trash, I don't give a shit about any of it. And I'm not coming.

-----

From: Judy Alvarez
To: Maiko Maeda
RE: take your shit

Nice you can afford to do that. I guess that's what you do with everything – throw it out like trash. No remorse, no regrets.
If you find any of MY shit, feel free to hand leave it on Jig-Jig Street for the people who need them.
As for your clothes – you could get jumped wearing this, so I'd rather just burn it.

title: Welcome to Heart Solutions!
text:
Dear Maiko,
Welcome to the elite service of Heart Solutions.
As the sole service provider on the market, we take what we do very seriously. We know that time is money for our clients – that's why we GUARANTEE you will find the right person within the next ninety days. If your future partner does not meet your expectations, we ensure a full refund.
In order to help start your journey, we'll send you a questionnaire that will allow our algorithm to choose the best person for your first date.

title: Thanks and sorry
text:
Hey Martha,
Thanks for the date. You're a nice girl and I like you, but it's just not going to happen.
Please don't take it personally – it's me. I realized that I'm not ready for a commitment yet.

title: Sending you something, hope you won't have to use it
text:
Hey.
Wish you had told me you were dropping by – I found some sketches of your projects recently. They're collecting dust in the kitchen now and I don't even know if you're still into that or if you gave up on it like you do with everything else once you get into something new.
I hope I managed to convince you to drop that insane fucking idea, but then again, who am I kidding – you won't.
Gotta admit, your timing was perfect as usual – right when I started to sort everything out and even met a girl who not only wouldn't throw me into depths of despair, but actually gave me a glimmer of hope I'd pull myself together, you turned up and reminded me that whatever she is to me, she'll never replace you.
Okay, enough wallowing. I just want you to know whatever you get into, I'm out. And remember that mercs don't care if a plan is good or not. For them, it's all about the eddies. Don't be naive thinking V is in this for the cause – it's either cash or some ulterior motive.
Anyway, you will probably need a gun and I'd rather it be in the hands of someone who knows how to use it. I'm sending it to your apartment.
I won't try to dissuade you because I know it'll have the opposite effect. If you ever decide you want to meet, just call me instead of coming in through the window with some thugs. I know you don't give two shits about protocol and procedures, but I work there and even though I want nothing to do with it, you'll still find a way to fuck it all up for me.

title: New contract
text:
Despite some setbacks, we should be able to finish the job by the agreed upon date. Can we meet to authorize the new contract?

-----

From: Jeffrey Simmons, Senior PM, Biotechnica
To: Saul Bright
RE: New contract
Unfortunately, the terms were not upheld and the contract has been rendered void. We are currently negotiating with another contractor to finish the job.

-----

From: Saul Bright
To: Jeffrey Simmons, Senior PM, Biotechnica
RE: New contract

We can slash the rate by 20%. You won't find anybody who will do it cheaper – and if they will, they'll botch it for sure. We have a reputation to uphold – the Aldecaldos never leave a job unfinished.

-----

From: Jeffrey Simmons, Senior PM, Biotechnica
To: Saul Bright
RE: New contract

We will consider renegotiating the contract at 25%. The job will then be categorized as a B41 and you will not be entitled to insurance coverage. If your honor permits, please confirm your acceptance of the aforementioned terms.

-----

From: Saul Bright
To: Jeffrey Simmons, Senior PM, Biotechnica
RE: New contract

Confirmed.

title: Third option
text:
I know, I know we talked about this a million times, but come on, say it –  you sailed up a dry creek.

If you don't want to listen to Panam, then listen to me. If honest smuggling's out, then better Snake Nation over the fucking corps. If we join Snake, we'll still be nomads, but if we keep serving the corpos I don't even know what you could call us.

-----

From: Saul Bright
To: Scorpion
RE: Third option

We have a contract with Biotechnica. End of discussion.

title: New Threat Level: High Alert
text:
With regard to the Net crash, we are pleased to inform you that communications have been restored and we are adjusting the threat level rating from Crisis Response (T-4) to High Alert (T-3).

All employees shall report for an informational meeting at 8:00 AM tomorrow in Hall E. The meeting will cover new operational procedures for the factory as well as new technology to be introduced. Attendance is mandatory.

title: rumor mill
text:
Ermoke, you really leaving? How come I'm the last to hear about it???

-----

From: Ermoke
To: Cat McCrae
RE: rumor mill

Yep, I'm leaving :( I wasn't sure how to tell you, I'm sorry you found out this way. I got a friend with the Red Willow clan, he'll put in a good word for me.

-----

From Cat McCrae
To: Ermoke
RE: rumor mill

Ermoke the Nomad? Come on. You always said nomads were a buncha dirty stinking backcountry hicks.

-----

From: Ermoke
To: Cat McCrae
RE: rumor mill

Cat, they're shutting the place down. We stay, they'll send us somewhere even worse... So if I gotta hit the road, rather decide for myself which road I take.

-----

From: Cat McCrae
To: Ermoke
RE: rumor mill

yeah, sure you'll have a say, bet you'll be head of the clan in no time

leave my stuff on the desk before you go

title: Closing of the Factory and Branch No. 12 at the Station
text:
The factory and branch office located at the station will be officially closed at the end of the month. All sections of track used for transport and logistics will be cut off from the main traction system. On the final day of operation, all employees will be required to return any company equipment as well as their building access cards.

-----

From: Jim Rosado
To: Michael Pilling-Fisher, CTO, CORP-BUD
RE: Closing of the Factory and Branch No. 12 at the Station

This is Jim from the station control tower.
I'm not sure if anyone will read this, considering we're shutting it all down, but – what about the engine we got here? I get the tracks, but the engine? Someone should probably take care of it, right? Pretty sure it's an environmental hazard.

-----

From: Michael Pilling-Fisher, CTO, CORP-BUD
To: Jim Rosado
RE: Closing of the Factory and Branch No. 12 at the Station

The engine will be removed in accordance with all applicable safety guidelines.

title: Over. My. Dead. Fucking. Body.
text:
I deleted the last bajillion messages, but whatever. You made a fucking fool of me and I won't forget that. Can you stop sticking your nose in my biz? (A nose which, I might add, is covered in shit from being so far up the asses of those cigar-smoking fat cats at the label. Or is it their noses up yours?) Either way, it's not like you care about what I want anyway. And no, I'm not planning on changing my signature.

Kerry Eurodyne
SUCK MY DICK, KOVACHEK

title: RE: Over. My. Dead. Fucking. Body.
text:
Kerry, I totally understand why you're upset at how things turned out. Of course, we can keep you posted on every single little detail, but how many times have I heard you say you don't "give a flying fuck" about particulars? Before I go tar and feather myself, let's look at this with a clear head. Everything went as well as it could've:  you have amazing PR, media presence is the best it's been in years, and a whole new chunk of listeners is getting into your music. You call it a failure of management – wanna know what I call it? A HUGE SUCCESS. Love you man,
–CB

title: RE: Over. My. Dead. Fucking. Body.
text:
If it was up to me, you'd be sitting in a Max-Tac quarantine cell for YOUR cyberpsychosis, 'cause only a cyberpsycho would dump this shit on me and call it their "opinion." Do you realize if I could fire you, you'd already be scraping the bottom of a feeder in Watson? Let me put this in words you'll understand: GO FUCK YOURSELF
PS: And yes, I CONFIRM that I don't want them to include me in that piece about celebrities with cyberpsychosis. Are you completely WHACKED?!
Kerry Eurodyne
SUCK MY DICK KOVACHEK

title: RE: Over. My. Dead. Fucking. Body.
text:

title: Old friend
text:
My dear Farida,

I know it's been ages and I'm truly sorry. I found myself in a few rough patches that forced me to go offline for a time.

This most recent patch, some friends of friends were willing to put me up while I recovered (nothing serious!). I only mention it 'cause, on my third day in their company, they played "Come as Sunshine" over breakfast. Jesus, how many years had it been, I wondered... I was literally crying out loud for crying out loud! They didn't know what to do with me.

Do you remember how we used to dance? No rhythm, no grace, moving our feet often more to static than actual music on that old radio. And girl, did we hooowl! I'm still surprised I had that in me. Shit, I even remember Tim and how used to gawk at you like a nervous goat.

Anyway, I suppose I'm writing you now because that was the last time I ever really felt at home. Anywhere. I miss you fierce, F. I think you're the last person I ever let myself truly get to know… Recently thought I had myself a great man too, but found out quick I was sorely mistaken. But that's another story for another time.

I know these old memories don't mirror the people we are now, but since hearing that song again, I just can't shake the feeling that I lost something important in my life.

I'm not asking you to follow me as I head east, I just want you to know I was thinking of you. Don't be a stranger.

Mabel

title: The Future of Project Cynosure
text:
Dearest colleagues,
It is with great regret that I must announce the termination of the Cynsoure project. We know how important this undertaking has been for yourselves and your careers and offer our deepest sympathies. We would like to ensure you that the Supervisory Board came to this decision on the basis of meticulous reports and analyses, motivated as we have always been by the well-being of our employees.
Cynosure was an enormously ambitous and pioneering project to such an extent that the results you have produced will not only steer the course of this department, but of the entire corporation. Cynosure widened and deepened our knowledge of AI and plumbed the farthest reaches of the Net. It has also proven that in the cyberspatial realm, it is man who wields power over artificial intelligence, not the other way around. This discovery has greatly reassured us all.
Information regarding further reassignment as well as special bonuses for former Cynosure employees will be communicated to you by your HR representatives.
Thank you for all of the hard work you poured into Cynosure and in your future endeavors here at Militech!
Marius Vaast
Director, Militech Special Projects Management Department

title: Urgent: regarding the recent incident
text:
To sum up - we're going to have to quickly slap together a statement of some kind to reassure folks that everything is under control. You know the drill. The actual truth of what happened is a separate issue - investigation is still underway, though from what I've heard our security systems were breached and interfered with by an "alien intelligence." As of yet we have no idea if and to what degree this "intelligence" has infiltrated the facility's infrastructure. Apparently, we'll never know. We're left groping blind. So just in case, beyond the standard protocols (we'll make sure none of this gets leaked to the media, fortify our communications, remind people of the consequences of discussing the incident, update our security), we'll have have to take drastic measures. Dymtro will bring counterintelligence to bear on the specifics, Irene will ask the armed forces for temporary assistance (at least something to deal with Cerberus?), Bret will see whether we can get any additional security specialists. That's it. You all know what to do. Keep me updated.
M.

title: Regarding the recent malfunction
text:
The following information aims to offer an explanation of the incident that occurred two days ago, referred to by the team as "accident", "malfunction", and "error jeopardizing personnel safety." We assure all employees that experts from our security division, in accordance with engineers from our technology and research departments, have conducted a cursory examination of the documentation regarding the incident and have unanimously concluded that there is no reason to be alarmed. The situation in the experimental lab is under control and poses no risk to personnel safety and their working conditions.
At the same time, we remind you that all personnel are obliged to adhere to clauses signed in their NDAs, including annex 34.v.1 introduced two days prior. Any discussion of the research conducted within this facility as well as the self-apparent, if unavoidable, incidents of various natures is prohibited. We thank you for your understanding and wish you a fruitful day.
Xiana Linda
Senior HR Specialist
R&D Department
Militech

title: A few concerns
text:
The results of our experiments are unsettling to say the least. All netrunners taking part in Project Cynosure have begun to display signs of psychological fatigue. It's possible the effects could worsen. Currently we're observing a tendency toward melancholy, increasing their introvertedness, memory loss, mild aphasia and depressive thoughts bordering on the suicidal. These symptoms are undoubtedly related to the experiments conducted as part of the project. Our professional recommendation is to put the project on hold in the interest of the netrunners' wellbeing and safety.

Prof. Alexis D.

---------------
From: Prof. Tamara G.
To: Prof. Alexis D.
RE: A few concerns

Thank you for candidly sharing your concerns with us regarding the project. As always, these insights are extremely valuable. However, taking into account the importance of this project and the imminent breakthrough we're anticipating, we unfortunately can't allow experimentation to be put on hold. If necessary, we may consider replacing the netrunners in question, though due to time concerns and the experience of our current crew, we would rather avoid that.

Nevertheless, we authorize you to make use of any substances - pharmacological or otherwise - to ensure the netrunners' readiness to continue testing.
Best of luck,
TG

title: NEURAL NETWORK STABILIZERS MUST ALWAYS BE ONLINE!
text:
I'm sending this message out far and wide because it's really important - THE NEURAL NETWORK STABILIZERS SHOULD ALWAYS BE ONLINE. Yesterday's incident could've been avoided if only the netrunner was connected to the stabilizers. But he wasn't. Understand this - without neural network stabilizers a netrunner's brain isn't capable of withstanding an encounter with a rogue AI. The sudden volume of data required to be processed (in the form of an attack from the AI) literally fries human synapses that are already preoccupied with the mere fact of being in cyberspace. Traditional hardware and software support is just not sufficient, which is why we created the stabilizers and why every netrunner MUST be connected to them. Granted, it decreases performance by a few percent, but at least after a deep dive the netrunner'll be able to get up from his chair on his own without foaming at the mouth and bleeding from his eyes.
Sincerely,
TG

title: Latest changes for operating Cerberus

Besides, remember that we're all in the same boat and need to work as team. So let's work as a team. Don't worry about a thing - it's all under control.

title: [Draft] Was it really a malfunction?
text: [Draft] In my view, the project's safeguards are still lacking. I have no access to external analysis, meanwhile management is claiming that it's monitoring the whole facility and tracking every bit of incoming and outgoing data. But that's as far as their reassurances go. Obviously it's in everyone's interest that nobody unauthorized ever finds out about this place, about this project. But the sins committed by megacorps are notoriously that of arrogance and hubris. They're unable to fathom that a Bartmoss or someone equal caliber are more effective than all our advanced AI and daemons. Even the best algorithm won't protect us from a determined and cunning independent netrunner who has nothing to lose. And what if Bartmoss already knows about us? What if what we're trying to do here, what we're trying to achieve reaches the light of day? Only thinking about the consequences gives me the shivers.

title: We need to be more careful
text:
Manuel, the truth is that what we're doing here is illegal in every way. We have to conceal this project from the competition - that much is obvious, but more importantly so that NetWatch doesn't catch our scent. That's a little more complicated. I need the best algorithms your team's got - we have to update this ICE every few minutes. What about that permutational code you promised us? We also need a more traditional smoke screen - maybe our intelligence could incite some kind of provocation that would focus NetWatch's attention on some other parts of Night City? Or another city altogether?

Looking forward to your reply.

Claudia
---------------

From: Manuel B.
To: Claudia W.
RE: We need to be more careful

Claudia, we're doing all we can. You'll get the ICE today - we'll handle NetWatch. In the worst case we'll grease their palms to look the other way. But let's not kid ourselves - you're the ones who're holed up in that bunker trying to circus-tame artificial intelligences, any of which - if let loose - could end the world as we know it. You know that's no exaggeration. My people will try to protect you from every angle. But if some rogue AI manages to escape, we're fucking done for. Remember that.

M.

title: Connection to old Net established
text:
Everything is going according to plan. We have managed to harness the bunker's systems to establish connection with the so-called old Net. Using its own protocols and algorithms will enable us to move around within cyberspace while avoiding unwanted attention and security measures. We're testing our hypothesis of using the old Net's protocols to approach the border of the Blackwall undetected and carefully reach beyond it. If we're successful in locating and capturing one of the AIs that lies beyond, we'll try to secure it with the infrastructure located here. Of course, it will be done in such a way as to not raise suspicion within NetWatch. According to our intelligence data, the agency is still wholly unaware of our presence here.
Sincerely,
Dr. Evan McRay

title: Unbearable memories
text:
Something happened to me yesterday. After a deep dive into cyberspace they whisked us away for the usual testing. At one point we got to those weird neurological tests that I always thought were kinda funny where they ask you questions that make no sense but apparently reveal something about yourself. You're probably familiar with some of them: "What is the sound of one hand clapping?", "What does a mouse running through a maze represent to you?" "What do you associate with the smell of freshly-roasted coffee?" and it was at that moment that I hesitated, because... well, I suddenly realized that I didn't know. What coffee tasted like. I know coffee IS, but that's it. Strange, right? The feeling passed when I made myself a cup of strong, black coffee, but I have to admit I was a little weirded out. What else have I potentially forgotten? Is it some kind of... side effect of my last few deep dives? I doubt it, since I've been doing them for years... Anyway, hope you're doing well, doc. Maybe the next time we meet you might have an explanation.
Lisa

title: Those fucking twins
text:
Evan, you were right about those twins. Except it's not because they're from Europe, or that they get a cushy office instead of slumming it like the rest of us - it's just that they're whacked in the head. The brother especially. During connection he doesn't say a word, just stares at you with his dead eyes like he's planning your murder. Either way, they're starting to assert themselves, give us orders, question our expertise. Almost like they're afraid of something. Did you know they suggested to the board that we should start wrapping things up here soon? I don't know, maybe this is just the paranoia talking, but I get the feeling they don't want us to get to the bottom of our research here. So then who the fuck are they really working for?! Don't write back. I don't even know if I'll actually send this. I already feel better just getting this off my chest.

See ya around,
Lisa

title: Whispers in the dark
text:
I'll tell you everything during our session, but... I don't know, I just feel better writing to you about this now. I can't give any details - company secrets, NDA, yadda yadda, but... I'm locked in this place and feel like... It all started with a ringing in my ear, like a really faint whine. But then within the whine I started to hear... words? Yeah, I know, auditory hallucinations and whatnot. Classic. But at night when I'd try to fall asleep I'd get the feeling like something was trying to understand me. Something. What exactly? I don't know. I hear it in the monitors. In the cables. The walls. Whispers in the dark. Nothing that makes any sense. Heh. Do I need new meds? Fresh air? Or maybe I've finally gone cuckoo?

Sincerely,
Lisa

P.S. Thanks for agreeing to receive these messages. Please don't reply. We'll talk about everything in our session.

title: This is a watershed moment
text:
I restate my request. Should we truly pass up on such an extraordinary opportunity? We are on the precipice of a breakthrough. We just need more time!
Dr. Evan McRay
---------------
From: Militech - Research Department
To: Dr. Evan McRay
RE: This is a watershed moment

Evan, we discussed this multiple times. The decision has been made. Gather your equipment and evacuate the premises. The situation is unstable as you're perfectly aware. You're not just poking the bear anymore. If we don't bury this under ground immediately, we could trigger a crisis that not even your worst nightmares could conjure up. I want to see you all in the office tomorrow. Healthy and in one piece.
Best regards,
JC
---------------
From: Dr. Evan McRay
To: Militech - Research Department
RE: This is a watershed moment

One week. That's all I ask. We'll do it - the Blackwall will understand us, communicate with us. But we need time to make sense of our communication. Just a few days - please.
---------------
From: Militech - Research Department

title: We have arrived at the facility
text:
We have arrived. The team is at work securing the location and our presence here has so far remained undetected.
Upon first glance, the bunker looks practically untouched. Later today we'll send our probes further into the facility to take readings from the core. Preliminary scans show that the facility is inactive and safe to conduct our research. If we manage to reach the equipment left behind and it turns out that the data gathered by the netrunners remains intact, it'll mean a breakthrough for the department. I am optimistic in that regard.
You requested that I not hesitate to include any comments unrelated to the task at hand. I applaud your keen intuition - I have the uncanny feeling that... something was waiting for us here. There's no other way to describe it. Someone's... presence embedded in the infrastructure, even though scans haven't detected any signs of life. If experiments on rogue AIs were conducted here, then maybe... their remnants are still here. Inactive. Dormant. Waiting. I'll keep you informed of our progress.

Sincerely,
Dr. Evan McRay

title: Blackwall contact established, but…
text:
Our people have succeeded in utilizing the bunker's infrastructure to approach the Blackwall and establish contact. Though we made every effort to ensure maximal security of the procedure, an incident occurred. The Blackwall (for simplicity's sake I use this term to refer to the rogue, powerful AIs of which we know very little of anyway) penetrated our security systems and using Lisa's neuro-interface attempted to take control over the core. We used standard as well as extraordinary deterrance methods, cutting off entire sections of the bunker to prevent the Blackwall from accessing our mainframe. The situation is currently under control and Lisa has been placed under specialist care.
I urge that we nevertheless proceed with the project. We have never been so close to establishing meaningful contact with the Blackwall. It is highly probable that what might appear as an attack was in fact an attempt at establishing communication. I would like to conduct a series of additional, controlled approaches to the Blackwall. I am convinced we will succeed.

Sincerely,
Dr. Evan McRay

title: Recruitment - change in strategy
text:
Data from recent weeks show clearly that the percentage of corporate employees who agree to cooperate with us remains unacceptably low. On average, only 1.3 out of 10 accept the offer to join us.

There are several reasons: moral objection, fear of losing current career, lack of proper motivation. Although information about the "systematic hacking of innocent citizens' cyberware" is beginning to take root in the media, still 8.7 out of 10 candidates do not take the threat to their health and life seriously.

I see one solution only. We must intensify our efforts, accelerate recruitment. To do that we must:
- broaden candidate criteria
- shorten the time we give them to decide
- reduce the number of "warnings" from 3 to 1 (i.e. hacks of less critical implants)

This is a numbers game. We cannot afford to be picky. I expect a list of fresh names for Milko tomorrow.

AN

text:
Info for everyone so it’s clear to you and the clients. We got basically the same drug, but two different strengths. Deep Dive's your first little leap into the deep end. Phant's the fuckin' abyss.
Deep Dive – how it works – it hits you like you were reliving a BD, but in real time. You imagine something and actually live through it. Like a lucid daydream you can control. No need to wait for someone else to scroll it; you can experience whatever you want. Someone tells you a story and you’re in it, man. It’s a preem trip, but you gotta be careful – if your choom tells you a shit story, could really bring you down hard. Seriously. Get a choom to tell you something nice, so you get to relive all the colors, emotions, smells, all that shit.
Phant – how it works – now we’re bringing out the elephant guns, huh? Deep dive’s a poly one-shot compared to phant. If we’re counting, Dive’s only about 20-25% the strength of phant (depending on purity, obvi). So while Deep Dive lets you relive someone else’s experiences like they were your own, phant just punches you in the face, grabs you by the metaphorical balls and tears you away to an astral plane of pure ecstasy. We’re talking life pre-phant and post-phant, that’s it. Once you get a taste, it’s all you can think about. Pre-phant is just a sad, gray thing of the past. Chooms, I mean it, if you haven’t tried phant then you got no idea the heights of happiness you can reach. That’s pretty much it. Sincerely, your prof of psychodelic sciences, meaning me, Mikhail

listen jan, I’m a little low on eds at the moment, but my memory chrome’s acting up. Could you take a look? Been forgetting stuff, sometimes find myself standing somewhere and I can’t remember what the hell I was doing for the last 15 minutes, like someone knocked me out or something

-----

From: Janet Arias
To: Leon Rinder
RE: memory lapses

Rinder, you do know I specialize in lower limb cyberware?

-----

From: Leon Rinder
To: Janet Arias 
RE: memory lapses

yeah I mean I said I was broke, but do me a favor? as a choom?

-----

From: Janet Arias
To: Leon Rinder
RE: memory lapses

ugh fine, come over. but I can’t promise anything

title: something to interest you
text:
I got the coords for the next airdrops in Dogtown. You know the risk, so you know how much this is worth. You want them or not?

-----

From: Sophia Dupont
To: Cory Waring
RE: something to interest you

How’d you get them? How do I know Hansen’s not tracking you already? Direct answers, please, or you’re down a client.

-----

From: Cory Waring
To: Sophia Dupont
RE: something to interest you

Look I ran with Militech. I know what I’m doing. I track down the drops using the tech they left from the war. You’d be amazed at the shit just lying around getting trampled here. And as for Hansen, I’ll put it this way – you take the risk, you’re in the game; you scared, you’re out.

-----

From: Sophia Dupont
To: Cory Waring
RE: something to interest you

Sophia Dupont is always in the game.

title: 72-hour unholy mass
text:
Choooom, let the countdown begin! In a millisec we’ll be on the dance floor, flying high and raging so hard we won’t be able to move the next day. Talkin’ head to toe pain, choom. Got everything you asked for – the preemest mods, the right priest for our unholy mass and a nova setup. All that’s left is to drop the skezz and break free from the everyday grind, man. Just gonna need you to bring enough gonkheads to the rave.

-----

From: Derek Frost
To: Wesley Hunt
RE: 72-hour unholy mass

Choombatta, don’t you worry. I’ll be bringin a whole fuckin flock of the wildest pilgrims ready get fucked up for a good time. THREE DAYS OF MAYHEM. FUCK YEA FINALLY. And the site? Anatomicon, with all that old robochrome? Fuuuuck the vibe’s gonna be siiiick.

title: how phant works
text:
Lorraine, listen, I’m trying to get to the bottom of this phant stuff. How it works, what the mechanism of addiction is. Could you send me the soft for those new Arasaka liver boosters?

---------------

To: Maggie Isley
RE: how phant works

All right, just remember if anything happens I’ll say you klepped the data from us.

title: you know what
text:
I got the stuff you asked for, the phant. took down the scavs guarding it, but then half of dtown started coming after me

might have a problem getting back over the border, looks like the scavs are in better with barghest than we thought

anyway I got the stuff, don’t worry, but I gotta lay low for a bit, let the dust settle

found a spot where I should be safe

title: skezzed self to future self hahaha
text:
First dose of phant - EUPHORIA, daaaaamn when it starts working it does something to your memory, you forget all about the bad shit and even though you’re sitting there alone you feel this sort of connection to everyone and everything, you feel like you’re part of the universe and everything’s going according to plan and it’s all FUCKING ECSTASY

phant, dose five - the ecstasy doesn’t diminish, it’s like you don’t build up a tolerance, I dunno what’s going on but all I want is for it to stay like this forever

phant, dose seven - think I’ll just stay here in this dump, nothing better waiting for me outside. or I’ll crawl out of here reborn, I dunno. got everything I need right here - me my bed and phant
